Clean Results
```{r}
library(dplyr)

clean_df <- function(df) {

  df <- df %>%
    select(where(~ !all(is.na(.))))

  colnames(df) <- make.names(as.character(unlist(df[1, ])), unique = TRUE)

  df <- df[-1, ]

  if (ncol(df) > 10) {
    df <- df[, seq_len(ncol(df) - 10)]
  }
  
  if (ncol(df) >= 1) {
    df <- df[, -1]
  }
  
  df <- df[, -2]

  return(df)
}

AE_ski_w <- clean_df(AE_ski_w)
```

Avg position
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

analyze_df_summary <- function(df) {
  
  df_long <- df %>%
    mutate(position = row_number()) %>%    
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -position,
      names_to = "event",
      values_to = "athlete"
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(athlete) & athlete != "")  
  
  df_summary <- df_long %>%
    group_by(athlete) %>%
    summarise(
      average_position = mean(position),
      best_finish = min(position),
      worst_finish = max(position),
      events_participated = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(average_position)   
  
  return(df_summary)
}
```

Clean Scores
```{r}
clean_df_x <- function(df) {
  colnames(df) <- df[1, ]
  df <- df[-1, ]
  rownames(df) <- NULL

  score_counter <- 1
  for(i in seq_along(df)) {
    numeric_test <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(df[[i]])))
    if(sum(!is.na(numeric_test)) > 0) { 
      df[[i]] <- numeric_test
      colnames(df)[i] <- paste0("Score", score_counter)
      score_counter <- score_counter + 1
    }
  }

  df <- df[, !sapply(df, function(x) all(is.na(x)))]

  return(df)
}
```

Pivot
```{r}
pivot_scores <- function(df) {

    score_cols <- grep("^Score", colnames(df))
  
  name_cols <- setdiff(seq_along(df), score_cols)
  
  all_names <- c()
  all_scores <- c()
  
  for(i in seq_along(name_cols)) {
    names_vec <- df[[name_cols[i]]]
    scores_vec <- df[[score_cols[i]]]
    
    keep <- !is.na(names_vec) & !is.na(scores_vec)
    
    all_names <- c(all_names, names_vec[keep])
    all_scores <- c(all_scores, scores_vec[keep])
  }
  
  new_df <- data.frame(ALL = all_names, Score0 = all_scores, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  return(new_df)
}
```

Normalize
```{r}
normalize_all <- function(df_list) {
  for (df_name in df_list) {
    df <- get(df_name)
    
    numeric_cols <- sapply(df, is.numeric)
    df[, numeric_cols] <- lapply(df[, numeric_cols, drop = FALSE], function(x) {
      max_val <- max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (max_val == 0 || is.na(max_val)) return(x)
      return(x / max_val * 100)
    })
    
    assign(paste0(df_name, "_norm"), df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
}
```

By Score Format
```{r}
sports <- c("AE", "MO", "HP", "SS", "BA")
genders <- c("m", "w") 

pad_to_max <- function(vec, len) {
  length(vec) <- len
  vec
}

sort_scores <- function(df) {
  df[order(-df$Score0), ]
}

combine_datasets <- function(prefix) {
  all_dfs <- list()
  
  for (sport in sports) {
    for (gender in genders) {
      df_name <- paste0("X_", sport, "_ski_", gender, "_", prefix)
      
      sorted_df <- sort_scores(get(df_name))
      
      key <- paste0(sport, gender)
      
      all_dfs[[paste0(key, "_Athlete")]] <- sorted_df$ALL
      all_dfs[[paste0(key, "_Score")]]   <- sorted_df$Score0
    }
  }
  
  max_len <- max(sapply(all_dfs, length))
  all_dfs_padded <- lapply(all_dfs, pad_to_max, len = max_len)
  
  as.data.frame(all_dfs_padded)
}

A_ski_WC        <- combine_datasets("WC")
A_ski_WCavg     <- combine_datasets("WCavg")
A_ski_norm_WC   <- combine_datasets("norm_WC")
A_ski_norm_WCavg <- combine_datasets("norm_WCavg")
```

By Sport
```{r}
sports <- c("AE", "MO", "HP", "SS", "BA")
genders <- c("m", "w")  

pad_to_max <- function(vec, len) {
  length(vec) <- len
  vec
}

sort_scores <- function(df) {
  df[order(-df$Score0), ]
}

combine_sport <- function(sport, gender) {
  dataset_types <- c("WC", "WCavg", "norm_WC", "norm_WCavg")
  combined <- list()
  
  for (dtype in dataset_types) {
    df_name <- paste0("X_", sport, "_ski_", gender, "_", dtype)
    
    sorted_df <- sort_scores(get(df_name))
    
    combined[[paste0(dtype)]]        <- sorted_df$ALL
    combined[[paste0(dtype, "_Score")]] <- sorted_df$Score0
  }
  
  max_len <- max(sapply(combined, length))
  combined_padded <- lapply(combined, pad_to_max, len = max_len)
  
  as.data.frame(combined_padded)
}

for (sport in sports) {
  for (gender in genders) {
    df_name <- paste0("AA_", sport, "_ski_", gender)
    assign(df_name, combine_sport(sport, gender), envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
}
```

medal prob1
```{r}
### --- Medal probability model (P_gold, P_podium) using NORMALIZED scores ---
### Assumptions:
### - Everyone in the discipline is competing
### - No ties (we break ties with tiny random jitter)
### - Any athlete outside top-25 by normalized mean gets P=0%
### - Uses per-athlete Normal(mean, sd) estimated from X_*_norm_WC (pivoted normalized results)

set.seed(123)

# 1) Settings
N_SIMS <- 20000
sports  <- c("AE", "MO", "HP", "SS", "BA")
genders <- c("m", "w")

# 2) Utility: compute medal probabilities for one discipline (e.g., "X_AE_ski_m")
medal_probs_norm <- function(base_name, n_sims = 20000, top_k = 25) {
  # Expect these to exist from your pipeline:
  #   <base_name>_norm_WC   (columns: ALL, Score0)  - multiple rows per athlete
  norm_wc_name <- paste0(base_name, "_norm_WC")
  if (!exists(norm_wc_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    stop("Missing dataset: ", norm_wc_name, call. = FALSE)
  }
  norm_wc <- get(norm_wc_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)

  # Basic checks
  if (!all(c("ALL", "Score0") %in% names(norm_wc))) {
    stop(norm_wc_name, " must have columns ALL and Score0.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  # Per-athlete mean + sd on normalized scores
  stats <- aggregate(Score0 ~ ALL, data = norm_wc, FUN = function(x) c(mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)))
  stats <- data.frame(
    Athlete = stats$ALL,
    Mean    = stats$Score0[, "mean"],
    SD      = stats$Score0[, "sd"],
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Clean SDs
  stats$SD[is.na(stats$SD)] <- 0
  stats$SD[stats$SD < 0] <- 0

  # If fewer than 2 athletes, probabilities are not meaningful
  if (nrow(stats) < 2) {
    stats$P_gold   <- 0
    stats$P_podium <- 0
    return(stats[order(-stats$Mean), ])
  }

  # Top-K cutoff (by normalized mean)
  stats <- stats[order(-stats$Mean), ]
  in_top <- seq_len(min(top_k, nrow(stats)))
  top_stats <- stats[in_top, , drop = FALSE]

  # Simulate one "Olympic score" per athlete
  # Add tiny jitter to force "no ties" behavior
  nA <- nrow(top_stats)
  means <- top_stats$Mean
  sds   <- top_stats$SD

  # Draw matrix: sims x athletes
  draws <- matrix(rnorm(n_sims * nA, mean = rep(means, each = n_sims), sd = rep(sds, each = n_sims)),
                  nrow = n_sims, ncol = nA)

  # Optional: clamp scores to [0, 100] since normalized scale
  draws[draws < 0]   <- 0
  draws[draws > 100] <- 100

  # Break ties deterministically with tiny noise (still reproducible with set.seed)
  draws <- draws + matrix(runif(n_sims * nA, min = 0, max = 1e-9), nrow = n_sims)

  # Gold: column with max each row
  gold_idx <- max.col(draws, ties.method = "random")
  gold_counts <- tabulate(gold_idx, nbins = nA)

  # Podium: top 3 each row
  top3_mat <- t(apply(draws, 1, function(x) order(x, decreasing = TRUE)[1:3]))
  podium_counts <- tabulate(as.vector(top3_mat), nbins = nA)

  # Convert to probabilities
  top_stats$P_gold   <- gold_counts / n_sims
  top_stats$P_podium <- podium_counts / n_sims

  # Merge back into full list; outside top-K => 0
  out <- stats
  out$P_gold   <- 0
  out$P_podium <- 0
  match_idx <- match(top_stats$Athlete, out$Athlete)
  out$P_gold[match_idx]   <- top_stats$P_gold
  out$P_podium[match_idx] <- top_stats$P_podium

  # Sort for readability (by P_gold then Mean)
  out <- out[order(-out$P_gold, -out$Mean), ]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

# 3) Run all 10 ski disciplines + assign outputs
# Output objects:
#   AAA_AE_ski_m_medal_probs, AAA_AE_ski_w_medal_probs, ..., AAA_BA_ski_w_medal_probs
for (sport in sports) {
  for (gender in genders) {
    base_name <- paste0("X_", sport, "_ski_", gender)
    out_name  <- paste0("AAA_", sport, "_ski_", gender, "_medal_probs1")

    assign(out_name,
           medal_probs_norm(base_name, n_sims = N_SIMS, top_k = 25),
           envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
}


```

medal prob 2
```{r}
# --- probs2: "ceiling-focused" probabilities ---
# Idea: drop all normalized scores < 50 BEFORE computing each athlete's mean/SD,
# then simulate P(gold) and P(podium) from those filtered (ceiling-ish) summaries.
# Anyone outside top 25 by filtered mean gets P=0.

set.seed(123)

# 1) Inputs
sports  <- c("AE", "MO", "HP", "SS", "BA")
genders <- c("m", "w")
MIN_SCORE <- 66
N_SIMS <- 50000

# 2) Build athlete-level summary after filtering low scores
ceiling_summary <- function(long_df, min_score = 50) {
  # long_df should have columns: ALL, Score0 (normalized 0-100)
  df <- long_df[!is.na(long_df$ALL) & !is.na(long_df$Score0), ]
  df <- df[df$Score0 >= min_score, ]

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(
      Athlete = character(0),
      Mean = numeric(0),
      SD = numeric(0),
      n = integer(0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  m <- aggregate(Score0 ~ ALL, data = df, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  s <- aggregate(Score0 ~ ALL, data = df, FUN = sd,   na.rm = TRUE)
  n <- aggregate(Score0 ~ ALL, data = df, FUN = function(x) sum(!is.na(x)))

  out <- merge(merge(m, s, by = "ALL", all = TRUE), n, by = "ALL", all = TRUE)
  colnames(out) <- c("Athlete", "Mean", "SD", "n")

  # If an athlete has only 1 remaining score, SD becomes NA; set to 0 (deterministic around mean)
  out$SD[is.na(out$SD)] <- 0

  # Sort by Mean descending
  out <- out[order(-out$Mean), ]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

# 3) Simulate P(gold) and P(podium) using filtered mean/SD
win_podium_probs2 <- function(pred_df, n_sims = 50000, top_k = 25) {
  # pred_df should have: Athlete, Mean, SD, n
  if (nrow(pred_df) < 2) {
    # Not enough athletes after filtering
    if (nrow(pred_df) == 1) {
      return(data.frame(
        Athlete = pred_df$Athlete,
        Mean50 = pred_df$Mean,
        SD50   = pred_df$SD,
        n50    = pred_df$n,
        P_gold = 0,
        P_podium = 0,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    } else {
      return(data.frame(
        Athlete = character(0), Mean50 = numeric(0), SD50 = numeric(0), n50 = integer(0),
        P_gold = numeric(0), P_podium = numeric(0),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
  }

  # Keep only top 25 by Mean; everyone else gets 0%
  pred_df <- pred_df[order(-pred_df$Mean), ]
  pred_top <- head(pred_df, top_k)
  pred_rest <- pred_df[(top_k + 1):nrow(pred_df), , drop = FALSE]
  pred_rest <- pred_rest[!is.na(pred_rest$Athlete), , drop = FALSE]

  A <- nrow(pred_top)

  # Draw scores (bounded to 0-100), add tiny jitter to avoid ties
  sim_mat <- matrix(rnorm(n_sims * A,
                         mean = rep(pred_top$Mean, each = n_sims),
                         sd   = rep(pred_top$SD,   each = n_sims)),
                    nrow = n_sims, ncol = A, byrow = FALSE)

  sim_mat <- pmin(pmax(sim_mat, 0), 100)
  sim_mat <- sim_mat + matrix(runif(n_sims * A, -1e-8, 1e-8), nrow = n_sims)

  # Determine gold and podium each sim
  gold_idx <- max.col(sim_mat, ties.method = "random")

  podium_counts <- integer(A)
  gold_counts   <- integer(A)

  gold_counts <- tabulate(gold_idx, nbins = A)

  # For podium: top 3 each sim
  top3_idx <- t(apply(sim_mat, 1, function(x) order(x, decreasing = TRUE)[1:3]))
  podium_counts <- tabulate(as.vector(top3_idx), nbins = A)

  out_top <- data.frame(
    Athlete  = pred_top$Athlete,
    Mean50   = pred_top$Mean,
    SD50     = pred_top$SD,
    n50      = pred_top$n,
    P_gold   = 100 * gold_counts / n_sims,
    P_podium = 100 * podium_counts / n_sims,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # Add back everyone else as 0%
  if (nrow(pred_rest) > 0) {
    out_rest <- data.frame(
      Athlete  = pred_rest$Athlete,
      Mean50   = pred_rest$Mean,
      SD50     = pred_rest$SD,
      n50      = pred_rest$n,
      P_gold   = 0,
      P_podium = 0,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    out <- rbind(out_top, out_rest)
  } else {
    out <- out_top
  }

  out <- out[order(-out$Mean50), ]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

# 4) Build probs2 for all 10 ski disciplines (m/w × AE/MO/HP/SS/BA)
for (sport in sports) {
  for (gender in genders) {

    # Uses your existing normalized pivoted datasets:
    # e.g., X_AE_ski_m_norm_WC (columns: ALL, Score0)
    long_name <- paste0("X_", sport, "_ski_", gender, "_norm_WC")

    # Summarize after filtering scores < 50
    pred2 <- ceiling_summary(get(long_name), min_score = MIN_SCORE)

    # Compute probs (top 25 only)
    probs2 <- win_podium_probs2(pred2, n_sims = N_SIMS, top_k = 25)

    # Save with requested naming: ...probs2
    out_name <- paste0("AAA_", sport, "_ski_", gender, "_medal_probs2")
    assign(out_name, probs2, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
}
```

medal prob3
```{r}
# -----------------------------
# probs3: use TOP 3 scores only
# -----------------------------

sports  <- c("AE", "MO", "HP", "SS", "BA")
genders <- c("m", "w")

# Compute athlete-level (top-k) mean/sd from a long df: columns ALL, Score0
athlete_topk_stats <- function(df_long, k = 3) {
  df_long <- df_long[!is.na(df_long$ALL) & !is.na(df_long$Score0), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(df_long) == 0) return(data.frame())

  split_scores <- split(df_long$Score0, df_long$ALL)

  out <- lapply(names(split_scores), function(a) {
    s <- sort(split_scores[[a]], decreasing = TRUE)
    s_top <- head(s, k)
    n <- length(s_top)
    mu <- mean(s_top)
    sdv <- if (n >= 2) sd(s_top) else 0
    data.frame(ALL = a, n_top = n, mu_top = mu, sd_top = sdv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  })

  do.call(rbind, out)
}

# Monte Carlo win/podium probabilities using Normal(mu, sd)
# Applies: sd floor for realism, and top-25 cutoff (others get 0 probs)
win_podium_probs_topk <- function(df_long, k = 3, sims = 20000, sd_floor = 3, topN = 25) {
  stats <- athlete_topk_stats(df_long, k = k)
  stats <- stats[!is.na(stats$mu_top), , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(stats) < 2) stop("Need at least 2 athletes to compute win probabilities.")

  # rank by top-k mean and apply topN cutoff
  stats <- stats[order(-stats$mu_top), ]
  stats$rank_mu <- seq_len(nrow(stats))
  in_top <- stats$rank_mu <= topN

  mu <- stats$mu_top
  sdv <- pmax(stats$sd_top, sd_floor)

  # simulate
  gold_ct  <- numeric(nrow(stats))
  pod_ct   <- numeric(nrow(stats))

  for (b in seq_len(sims)) {
    draws <- rnorm(nrow(stats), mean = mu, sd = sdv)

    # gold = max draw
    i_gold <- which.max(draws)
    gold_ct[i_gold] <- gold_ct[i_gold] + 1

    # podium = top 3 draws
    top3_idx <- order(draws, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(3, length(draws))]
    pod_ct[top3_idx] <- pod_ct[top3_idx] + 1
  }

  stats$P_gold   <- 100 * gold_ct / sims
  stats$P_podium <- 100 * pod_ct  / sims

  # apply the "outside top 25 -> 0%" rule
  stats$P_gold[!in_top]   <- 0
  stats$P_podium[!in_top] <- 0

  # nice output
  stats[, c("ALL", "n_top", "mu_top", "sd_top", "rank_mu", "P_gold", "P_podium")]
}

# Build all 10 probs3 dfs from the normalized pivoted datasets: X_<SPORT>_ski_<m/w>_norm_WC
for (sport in sports) {
  for (gender in genders) {
    src_name  <- paste0("X_", sport, "_ski_", gender, "_norm_WC")
    out_name  <- paste0("AAA_", sport, "_ski_", gender, "_medal_probs3")

    df_long <- get(src_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)

    assign(
      out_name,
      win_podium_probs_topk(df_long, k = 3, sims = 20000, sd_floor = 3, topN = 25),
      envir = .GlobalEnv
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
assert_cols <- function(df, cols) {
  missing <- setdiff(cols, colnames(df))
  if (length(missing) > 0) stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  TRUE
}

safe_get <- function(name) {
  if (exists(name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) get(name, envir = .GlobalEnv) else NULL
}

trim_ws <- function(x) gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$", "", x)

canon_name <- function(x) trim_ws(as.character(x))

filter_competitors <- function(df, competitors) {
  assert_cols(df, c("ALL", "Score0"))
  df$ALL <- canon_name(df$ALL)
  df <- df[!is.na(df$ALL) & df$ALL != "" & !is.na(df$Score0), , drop = FALSE]
  df[df$ALL %in% competitors, , drop = FALSE]
}

apply_floor50 <- function(df) {
  df[df$Score0 >= 50, , drop = FALSE]
}

keep_top3_per_athlete <- function(df) {
  df <- df[order(df$ALL, -df$Score0), , drop = FALSE]
  idx <- ave(df$Score0, df$ALL, FUN = seq_along) <= 3
  df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
}

summarize_mu_sigma <- function(df) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(ALL = character(0), mu = numeric(0), sigma = numeric(0), n = integer(0)))
  }
  agg_mu <- aggregate(Score0 ~ ALL, data = df, FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  agg_sd <- aggregate(Score0 ~ ALL, data = df, FUN = function(x) stats::sd(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  agg_n  <- aggregate(Score0 ~ ALL, data = df, FUN = function(x) sum(!is.na(x)))
  out <- merge(merge(agg_mu, agg_sd, by = "ALL", suffixes = c("_mu", "_sd")), agg_n, by = "ALL")
  colnames(out) <- c("ALL", "mu", "sigma", "n")
  out$sigma[is.na(out$sigma)] <- 0
  out
}

medal_probs_from_mu_sigma <- function(params, n_sims = 50000, seed = 123) {
  if (is.null(params) || nrow(params) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      Athlete = if (!is.null(params) && nrow(params) == 1) params$ALL else character(0),
      mu = if (!is.null(params) && nrow(params) == 1) params$mu else numeric(0),
      sigma = if (!is.null(params) && nrow(params) == 1) params$sigma else numeric(0),
      n = if (!is.null(params) && nrow(params) == 1) params$n else integer(0),
      P_gold = if (!is.null(params) && nrow(params) == 1) 1 else numeric(0),
      P_podium = if (!is.null(params) && nrow(params) == 1) 1 else numeric(0),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }

  set.seed(seed)
  A <- params$ALL
  mu <- params$mu
  sdv <- params$sigma

  eps <- 1e-9
  sims <- sapply(seq_along(A), function(i) {
    rnorm(n_sims, mean = mu[i], sd = sdv[i]) + runif(n_sims, -eps, eps)
  })
  colnames(sims) <- A

  winner_idx <- max.col(sims, ties.method = "random")

  gold_counts <- tabulate(winner_idx, nbins = ncol(sims))
  P_gold <- gold_counts / n_sims

  top3_idx <- t(apply(sims, 1, function(x) order(x, decreasing = TRUE)[1:3]))
  podium_counts <- tabulate(as.vector(top3_idx), nbins = ncol(sims))
  P_podium <- podium_counts / n_sims

  out <- data.frame(
    Athlete = A,
    mu = mu,
    sigma = sdv,
    n = params$n,
    P_gold = P_gold,
    P_podium = P_podium,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out <- out[order(-out$P_gold, -out$P_podium, -out$mu), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

apply_top25_zero <- function(prob_df) {
  if (is.null(prob_df) || nrow(prob_df) == 0) return(prob_df)
  ord <- order(-prob_df$mu, -prob_df$P_gold, -prob_df$P_podium)
  prob_df <- prob_df[ord, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(prob_df) > 25) {
    prob_df$P_gold[26:nrow(prob_df)] <- 0
    prob_df$P_podium[26:nrow(prob_df)] <- 0
  }
  prob_df <- prob_df[order(-prob_df$P_gold, -prob_df$P_podium, -prob_df$mu), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(prob_df) <- NULL
  prob_df
}

run_medal_probs_variant <- function(df_name_norm_wc, competitors,
                                   variant = c("probs1", "probs2", "probs3"),
                                   n_sims = 50000, seed = 123) {
  variant <- match.arg(variant)
  df <- safe_get(df_name_norm_wc)
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  df <- filter_competitors(df, competitors)

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  if (variant == "probs2") {
    df <- apply_floor50(df)
  } else if (variant == "probs3") {
    df <- keep_top3_per_athlete(df)
  }

  params <- summarize_mu_sigma(df)
  prob_df <- medal_probs_from_mu_sigma(params, n_sims = n_sims, seed = seed)
  prob_df <- apply_top25_zero(prob_df)
  prob_df
}

sports <- c("AE", "MO", "HP", "SS", "BA")
genders <- c("m", "w")

N_SIMS <- 50000
SEED0  <- 777

for (sport in sports) {
  for (gender in genders) {

    base_norm_wc <- paste0("X_", sport, "_ski_", gender, "_norm_WC")

    # outputs
    out1 <- paste0("AAAA_", sport, "_ski_", gender, "_medal_probs1_OOO")
    out2 <- paste0("AAAA_", sport, "_ski_", gender, "_medal_probs2_OOO")
    out3 <- paste0("AAAA_", sport, "_ski_", gender, "_medal_probs3_OOO")

    if (!exists(base_norm_wc, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      assign(out1, data.frame(), envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign(out2, data.frame(), envir = .GlobalEnv)
      assign(out3, data.frame(), envir = .GlobalEnv)
      next
    }

    probs1 <- run_medal_probs_variant(base_norm_wc, ski_competitors, "probs1", n_sims = N_SIMS, seed = SEED0 + 1)
    probs2 <- run_medal_probs_variant(base_norm_wc, ski_competitors, "probs2", n_sims = N_SIMS, seed = SEED0 + 2)
    probs3 <- run_medal_probs_variant(base_norm_wc, ski_competitors, "probs3", n_sims = N_SIMS, seed = SEED0 + 3)

    assign(out1, probs1, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    assign(out2, probs2, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    assign(out3, probs3, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
}
```
